notes:
PASS on the fake backend only (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card's entry symbols are Gymnasium task environment classes, not MuJoCo models; this package serves the card's models[2], the RBY1A MJCF src/kinder/envs/dynamic3d/models/rby1a/rby1a_model_v1.2.xml (the file RBY1ARobotEnv inserts into the dynamic3d scene), through the card's MujocoDriver. models[0] (kinova_gen3/scene.xml) was not used because four of its seven position actuators declare no ctrlrange, so the bridge cannot publish a bound for those controls; every one of the RBY1A model's 24 motors inherits -3000000..3000000 from the root default class, which makes the whole action contract derivable and testable. The task environment wrappers (objects, observations, rewards, goals, episode limits) are not served. The model is read from the read-only clone in place; neither the model nor its meshes are copied. WHAT WAS NOT COVERED: MuJoCo itself is not installed where the gate runs (no network, no pip), so the sim backend (the real mujoco module) was not run and no trajectory was compared with the engine. The fake backend is the package's stand-in mujoco module (a callable, which the gate treats as the upstream simulator): it parses the model file for the model name, joint counts, actuator count and per-actuator ctrlranges, then advances a placeholder first-order motion; it resolves no mesh, inertia, contact, equality constraint or actuator dynamics. The model file states no <option timestep>; the published 2.0 ms timestep is the fake's placeholder for the MuJoCo library default, while the upstream dynamic3d environment sets 0.0005 s when it composes a scene (mujoco_utils.py:27,774-781), so the real step is not verified. The model has qpos 35, qvel 34 and ctrl 24, one free root joint plus 28 hinge or slide joints and 24 motors; the state fields are the bridge's full integration state. EXPECTED WARNINGS, none of which fails the gate: G6.NOT_RECORDED (the fake is the upstream simulator callable, so native calls are not recorded), G7.UPSTREAM_BACKEND (same reason: no fake surface is checked), and G8.NO_UNIT x3 (seed, ticks and action.ctrl[*], the integer and simulator-unit inputs the bridge derives; these are expected for simulator families). No G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings. No hardware was attached and no hardware backend was run; the package is model-authored and reviewed_by stays null, so nothing here is a human or hardware claim.

MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-10-30; reviewed_by stays null): accepted; the reviewer changed no file of the package. After the registry rebuild refreshed task.json, the reviewer re-ran the gate and wrote its digest above.

MODEL REVIEW (gpt-6, a model and not a human, 2026-11-02; reviewed_by stays null): Accepted the shared MuJoCo checkpoint v2 migration after independent codec review and this actual G1-G9 fake gate rerun. The explicit basic fallback does not claim complete integration state. Earlier automatically inferred determinism is superseded by the current reference. Changed reference.json, REFERENCE.md, check-report.json, RESULT.json. Source pin, package model authorship and driver.lock.json are unchanged. No native runtime of this package or physical hardware was validated; isolated SDK engine tests are separate evidence.
